**How it was tested**

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass in `web/` (if the frontend changed)
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) are updated
- [ ] No new dependency, or it is explained in docs/architecture.md §4 and listed in `release/third-party-modules.txt`
- [ ] No music, databases, `.env` files or keys are included
